verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੁਜਨਤਾਈ ਪਾਹਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬੈਰ ਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh kee sujanataiee paahan kee rekh preet bair jal rekh hui bisekh saadh sa(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: The loving relationship of Guru-oriented persons is like a line drawn on stone slab and is indelible. That is, the significance of company of Guru oriented persons is, that there is no ill feeling or animosity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨਤਾ ਅਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਬੈਰ ਤਉ ਪਖਾਨ ਰੇਖ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhurajanataa asaadh preet jal rekh ar bair tau pakhaan rekh sekh a(n)g a(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: Love of self oriented persons is momentary like a line drawn on water while their enmity remains like a line on a stone slab. It becomes part of their limb.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਜਲ ਬਾਰੂਨੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਲ ਗੰਗ ਮੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaasaT agan gat preet bipreet surasaree jal baaroonee saroop jal ga(n)g mai ||

en.bdb: A Gurmukhs love is like that of wood; it keeps it’s fuel of fire hidden within. Company of evil-minded people leaves bad effects and company of good people leaves good effect.  Similarly, pure water from the river Ganges can be polluted with wine.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਜਯਾ ਸਰਪ ਗਤਿ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਢੰਗ ਹੀ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਮੈ ॥੨੯੭॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat gurmat ajayaa sarap gat upakaaree aau bikaaree dda(n)g hee kudda(n)g mai ||297||

en.bdb: A person with base and impure mind is like a snake who commits evil due to its bad trait. It is always ready to harm. But a Guru-oriented person is like a goat which is always ready to do a good deed. (297)
